_comment: Rebuilt 2026-09-16. The previous contents planned v7.9 for 30 Sept while the plugin
was already at 7.18.0 and v7.11.0 was a tag - the SECOND time this file scheduled a
version that had shipped; v7.19 was the third. `gate --audit` now reports a milestone
at or below the highest of plugin.json, the newest tag and CHANGELOG (REQ-PLANSTALE-1013).
Milestones are written in full, vX.Y.Z, the same form as tags and CHANGELOG headings.
`until` is pinned on purpose. The engine computes the horizon (year end, or three months
out) only for a plan with no dates; once bars or dues exist, the calendar ends at the
last of them. Without `until` this chart would stop at v8.0.0's due date.

bars.title: MCP server: expose reqmap as a tool
An outside evaluator, on their own repo, with no help at the gate. Done when: they have `uses: alxmax/requirement-manager/check@v8` on a tree you do not commit to
Words match the engine
bars.roadmap: The words about `sync` match what it does. Done when: `docs/commands.md:62` and `mcp.py:127` say an edited confirmed contract is demoted to draft (they say `sync` refuses), and `app/scripts/sync-data.mjs:4` points to `sync`, not to `reqmap.py export`, which no longer exists

bars.title: Release waits for the smoke test
bars.roadmap: A release waits for the published-action smoke test. Done when: `release` does not go ahead while `dogfood.yml` is red

bars.title: The plan keeps only what is open
bars.roadmap: The plan keeps only what is open. Done when: the bar for the shipped MCP server and the one for the archived consumer repo, with that repo's ROADMAP item and the done licence line, are gone, and the outside-evaluator bar stays

bars.title: Read the clause-without-case questions, family by family
bars.roadmap: The `clause-without-case` questions are read family by family, as the guesses they are (ADR-0075: 7 of 20 real). Done when: ARCH-VIEWER-007's nine are read, and the next four families by count too: add the cases that are really missing with their tests, and leave a clause a case already proves as it is

bars.title: accept-drift does not report what it just accepted
bars.roadmap: `sync --accept-drift` does not report the drift it has just accepted. Done when: after `accepted drift on N confirmed contract(s)` and `lock updated.`, no RM018 line names those requirements

bars.title: The skill's engine copy has a requirement
bars.roadmap: The skill's engine copy has a requirement. Done when: `scripts/bundle_skill_engine.py` and its test are tagged to a confirmed requirement and `gate --risk` lists no untagged file

bars.title: JSON list contract: title from its first item
bars.roadmap: A JSON source row whose contract is a list and has no title takes the list's first item as its title. Done when: `sourcerows.blocks` titles such a row with its first clause (today it gets the list's Python text, `['A refund goes to the card.', ...]`), a test proves it, and REQ-CUSTOMTRACE-1138 is read again and confirmed

bars.title: retire: string literals in JS/TS
bars.roadmap: `retire --delete` and its requirement agree on string literals. Done when: the maintainer picks one: the clause says Python strings only, or the scanner blanks JS/TS strings as it does Python's; it lands with a test on a `.ts` member, and REQ-RETIRE-1130 is read again and confirmed

bars.title: Bugs drafts: @unit tests (RM010)
bars.roadmap: The bug-file drafts tested only `@integration` gain a `@unit` test. Done when: REQ-BUGS-1117, 1118, 1119, 1120, 1126, 1127, 1128, 1129 and 1131 each have a `@unit` `tested-by:` and `gate --full --strict` reports no RM010 for them once they are confirmed

bars.title: Other drafts: @unit tests (RM010)
bars.roadmap: REQ-CHECK-1135, REQ-MAPSTAMP-1124, REQ-MAPSTAMP-1125 and REQ-SCAN-1136 gain a `@unit` test. Done when: each has a `@unit` `tested-by:` and `gate --full --strict` reports no RM010 for them once they are confirmed

bars.title: Split drafts over 7 cases
bars.roadmap: Drafts with more than 7 cases are split. Done when: REQ-BUGS-1116 (10 cases), REQ-BUGS-1119 (8) and REQ-BUGS-1127 (8) hold 7 or fewer, each criterion moved to the requirement that owns it

bars.title: Drafts under 3 cases
bars.roadmap: Drafts with fewer than 3 cases gain the missing ones. Done when: REQ-CHECK-1135 (2 cases) and ARCH-MAPSTAMP-079 (1) reach 3, each with its test

bars.title: file-spread: keep or split
bars.roadmap: Code spread over 3 or more directories is kept as one capability or split. Done when: ARCH-BUGS-078, REQ-CHECK-1133 and REQ-VIEWER-1145 are each either split or exempted from `file-spread` with the reason in their Context

bars.title: ARCH-MAPSTAMP-079: code or aggregate
bars.roadmap: ARCH-MAPSTAMP-079 gets code and a test of its own, or becomes an aggregate. Done when: RM006 and RM007 no longer fire for it once it is confirmed

bars.title: Bugs tab: cases the read found missing
bars.roadmap: The Bugs tab's confirmed requirements close the gaps the read found. Done when: REQ-BUGS-1122's clauses 4 (a saved bug shows at once) and 6 (cancelling the picker keeps the form) each have a case and a test, and REQ-BUGS-1123's CASE-2 test filters the list instead of passing the filter label by hand

bars.title: Trace block: test the caps
bars.roadmap: The trace block's caps are tested. Done when: a test proves a suggestion lists at most 3 tests and a design rule keeps at most 50 hits

bars.title: retire: undo the cut tags on failure
bars.roadmap: A failed `retire --delete` leaves the member files as they were. Done when: when a later member file cannot be written, the tags already cut from earlier files are put back, and a test proves it

bars.title: init: the wire-the-gate path
bars.roadmap: `init`'s "wire the gate" line names the engine path the repository runs. Done when: it prints the same relative or bare path as the assistant block below it, instead of a fixed `python scripts/reqmap.py gate`

bars.title: German text reviewed
bars.roadmap: The German viewer text is read by a native reader. Done when: each correction lands in `app/src/lib/i18n.de.js`, and the smoke check that every language translates the same strings still passes
